g.title: E46_PEDAL
g.text: 6-pin dual-track hall-effect sensor. Two fully independent circuits. Total current draw: ~20 mA. 24 AWG wire sufficient on all pins. APS2 voltage is intentionally ~half APS1 at every pedal position. MaxxECU cross-checks ratio -- disagrement triggers e-throttle shutdown. Bench-verified pinout: HP Academy forum + openinverter.org BMW pedal wiki. Source used E46 pedal: eBay $30-80. New OEM: ~$130-140. Adapter bracket: Strom Motorsports / Garagistic / Boost Monkey / Drift HQ (~$40-60 each). RHD fitment unconfirmed -- contact vendor before ordering.

g.title: CABLE_PEDAL_TO_BULKHEAD
g.text: Cabin-side cable: E46 pedal connector to bulkhead cabin face. 24 AWG sufficient -- total circuit draw ~20 mA. Shielded 6-conductor; drain shield to chassis GND at MaxxECU end only (single-end drain prevents ground loops). Wire 1 BK: APS1 GND (Pin 1). Wire 2 BK: APS2 GND (Pin 2). Wire 3 RD: VCC2 (Pin 3). Wire 4 GN: APS1 signal (Pin 4). Wire 5 RD: VCC1 (Pin 5). Wire 6 YE: APS2 signal (Pin 6). Route through cabin, away from audio wiring. No high-current sharing.

g.title: BULKHEAD_CABIN
g.text: Deutsch Autosport AS-series firewall bulkhead -- CABIN SIDE
Size 20 contacts -- pins 72-77 assigned to e-pedal APS signals

Panel-mount receptacle, cabin side. Pins 72-77 are cavity-plugged in Phase 1 (M52 has no DBW pedal) and wired at Phase 3 (07K swap). The cabin-side cable run (E46 pedal :: bulkhead face) is the ONE cabin-side harness addition at swap. Size 20 contacts rated 7.5A continuous -- more than sufficient for 20mA. Use Size 20 sockets (cable side) with 22-24 AWG range crimp tooling. Bulkhead backshell: Raychem DR-25 over strain relief on cabin side.

g.title: BULKHEAD_ENGINE
g.text: Deutsch Autosport AS-series firewall bulkhead -- ENGINE SIDE
Size 20 contacts -- pins 72-77 assigned to e-pedal APS signals

Part of the 07K engine harness plug (maxxecu-07k.wv BULKHEAD_ENGINE_07K). Cavity-plugged on M52 engine-side plug -- M52 swap does not require touching these pins. Engine side of 72-77 wires to MaxxECU CMC APS inputs. AIN channel numbers for APS1/APS2 TBD -- assign in MTune and document in maxxecu-07k.wv once confirmed.

g.title: CABLE_BULKHEAD_TO_MAXXECU
g.text: Engine-side cable: bulkhead engine face to MaxxECU CMC connector. Short run -- MaxxECU is mounted on firewall in engine bay. Same color coding as cabin side for traceability. Drain shield here (to MaxxECU SGND or chassis GND) -- this is the single shield drain point for the entire pedal signal path.

g.title: MAXXECU_APS
g.text: MaxxECU RACE -- Analog Inputs + Sensor Supply + Sensor GND
CMC connector -- AIN pins TBD, 5V SENS OUT, SGND

Assign lowest available AIN numbers for APS1 and APS2 (e.g. AIN 5 / AIN 6). MaxxECU has two independent +5V sensor supply outputs -- use separate ones for each pedal circuit if available; tie to same output only if MaxxECU current budget allows (check MaxxECU Race +5V sensor supply max load). MTune path: Settings, E-Throttle, Pedal position. Run e-throttle calibration wizard after wiring -- captures min/max automatically.
